subject.title: fix(crestodian): keep onboarding connected through restart

question: After the two defects are repaired, should the three linked bug fixes remain bundled with the provider, plugin-runtime, dependency, packaging, and onboarding migration?
rationale: The branch crosses multiple compatibility- and security-sensitive owner boundaries beyond the linked bugs, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish that the combined merge scope is intended.

options.title: Split to linked fixes
options.body: Keep restart continuity, deterministic handoff, and profile isolation in a focused PR and review the broader runtime/dependency migration separately.

options.title: Approve combined migration
options.body: Retain the combined branch with explicit owner approval and complete fresh-install, upgrade, provider, plugin, dependency, and packaged proof.

options.title: Pause for redesign
options.body: Hold the PR until a smaller canonical owner-boundary design is agreed.

recommendation.title: Split to linked fixes
recommendation.body: Keep restart continuity, deterministic handoff, and profile isolation in a focused PR and review the broader runtime/dependency migration separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has recent merged onboarding history and is identified by GitHub as the trusted security-role actor for the dependency graph change.
